## Load dataset

Data on distance recordings from a paper plane folding/flying experiment.

```{webr-r}
library(paperplanes)
head(paperplanes)
```


## Visualise data

```{webr-r}
plot(distance ~ age, data = paperplanes)
```


## Fit model

Fit a linear model to analyse how does flight distance differ with age, gender or paper type:

```{webr-r}
model <- lm()
summary(model)
```


## Visualise model

```{webr-r}
library(visreg)
visreg(model)
```


## Check model

```{webr-r}
library(easystats)
check_model(model)
```
